summary: Iter 128 — Full backend + frontend validation of the 5 Godmode features: (1) SimulationsPage rewritten as premium Argumentation-Prep Launchpad (Text-Sim removed), (2) new public /for-teams Enterprise landing with lead capture, (3) argumentation-prep PDF export, (4) user-context injection in prep endpoint, (5) masterclass license redeem endpoint present. 8/8 pytest tests passed. All frontend data-testids resolved. DB persistence for enterprise_leads verified (source='enterprise_landing_public', priority hot/warm correct).
critical_code_review_comments: EnterpriseLandingPage.js is ~525 lines — near the 700 limit but still fine; consider splitting sections into /components/enterprise/* if it grows further.
enterprise/public-lead has no rate limiting or CAPTCHA — public endpoint could be spammed; recommend adding basic rate limit (e.g., 10/min per IP) before broad launch.
public-lead accepts any string as email (Pydantic doesn't validate format because field is `str` not `EmailStr`); recommend switching to EmailStr for validation.

No email confirmation is sent to the lead submitter — success screen promises 'wir melden uns innerhalb von 24h' but relies fully on manual follow-up; consider triggering an auto-acknowledgment email like the masterclass welcome one.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids resolved, form submit end-to-end works)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed enterprise_leads via public-lead endpoint (3 test leads); consider cleanup: db.enterprise_leads.deleteMany({company_name: {$regex:'^TEST_'}}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iter 128 features validated end-to-end. Enterprise leads flow works publicly. Argumentation-prep PDF returns >5KB valid PDF with proper Content-Disposition. User-context injection does not break either the new-user or repeat-user path (both return 200). SimulationsPage no longer has any chat UI. Login via /api/auth/login with email/password works for free@wladbot.test. Masterclass welcome email trigger was only smoke-tested (endpoint existence + validation); no unused license key was available in DB to actually redeem.
